The last train

A tiny story about a station, a suitcase, and a new beginning.

At the station, Mara bought a ticket to the first place whose name she could not pronounce. “Return?” the clerk asked. She looked down at the suitcase. It held a sweater, three notebooks, and a photograph of the sea. “Not yet,” she said. Outside, the rain stopped. For a moment the platform shone like a river.
